segs.t: Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy
Effective date:
November 6, 2026

This policy explains how SSOL Astro House handles information that could say something about your physical or mental health. It is written for Washington's My Health My Data Act, and we apply it to every user. It adds to our Privacy Policy; where they differ, this policy applies to consumer health data.
What counts as consumer health data here
Your birth chart and star report are astrology content, not health information. Some things you share with us, or that we create from your answers, could still be linked to your wellbeing:

rows: Answers about your concerns and wishes
The main area you worry about, the word you chose for your year, what you hope for next year
Your wellness type and the self-care suggestions in your report
Created by us from your answers
Anything you choose to say about your mood, stress, sleep, body or mental health

segs.t: We do not ask for medical records, diagnoses, medications or precise location, and we do not use geofencing.
Why we collect and use it
To show your results and create your star report
To tailor your Sowella AI chat and reply to you
To spot messages that suggest a crisis and show you crisis support contacts
We collect consumer health data only as needed to provide the service you ask for, or with your consent. We never use it for advertising, and we never send it to Google Analytics or X.
Who we share it with
We do not sell consumer health data. We do not share it with third parties or affiliates for their own use. If that ever changes, we will ask for your separate consent first.
Only the service providers that run the Service for us process it, under contract and only on our instructions:

rows: Vercel Inc. and Supabase, Inc. (servers in India, Mumbai region)
Hosting and database for Sowella AI

segs.t: Your rights
You can:
confirm whether we collect or share your consumer health data, and see it, including a list of every third party and affiliate it was shared with and how to contact them;
withdraw your consent;
ask us to delete it. We also tell our service providers to delete it. Copies in backups are deleted within 6 months.

Email contact@ssolwellness.com with the subject "Health data request". We may ask you to confirm your identity. We answer within 45 days. If we need up to 45 more days, we will tell you why. Requests are free up to twice a year, and we will not treat you differently for using your rights.
Appeals.

If we turn down your request, email us with the subject "Appeal" within 45 days. We will reply in writing within 45 days and explain our decision. If we deny your appeal, you can complain to the Washington State Attorney General at www.atg.wa.gov/file-complaint.
How we protect it
Only staff who need it can access consumer health data. We encrypt it in transit and protect it with access controls.
